comment: Encounter-wide authored values, shared by every encounter (K14). The player body is sized independently of any enemy (G08). Per-encounter values (rulesVersion, displayName, primaryArchetype, spawns, session) live under encounters. The player body is the Paladin class image's 6 x 8 body-and-arm mask: 0.667 x 0.889 tiles (6/9 and 8/9), with the asymmetric convex paladin-body outline recorded in docs/player-body-source.md (V11 X01). The 8 x 8 frame remains 0.889 x 0.889.

presentation.comment: Trainer-authored, not sourced: how long a lob's detonation circle is telegraphed before it goes off.

spawns.comment: Opening enemy at t=0 is schedule index 0; firstSpawnSeconds is the first additional spawn, so spawns land at 0, 10, 20 and 30 seconds. ringRadiusFraction 0.84375 is exactly 16.2/19.2, the approved spawn distance.

K10: a single boss, not a swarm. One enemy at t=0 and never again - everySeconds null means the periodic schedule never repeats. P40: arena-center replaces farthest-from-player so she no longer walks in from 16.2 tiles out during a phase-3 drill; her phase-3 move-to-point movement stays authored as-is and is now a no-op at spawn.
